note: The organiser publishes a live monthly schedule for the market at Red Hill Recreation Reserve and names its operator as the Red Hill Agricultural & Horticultural Society. Read first hand. Recorded also as primary evidence for register item A25: it establishes which market that Society runs at that reserve, and it says nothing whatsoever about the Red Hill Community Market or about any predecessor at the same ground. Which of the two corpus venue records describes the market operating there is an editorial decision and is not settled here.
